quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes CSV/HTML import, z-order-aware preview selection, Colors tab vertical expansion, custom WOFF2/WOFF/TTF/OTF font import through FontFace, portrait preset preview fitting, layer editing, and WebP export. Cross-browser, real-device, and very large font storage edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, and browser-local custom font storage.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, user guide is present, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested improvements passed: Colors tab vertical expansion, preview z-order selection, preset fit for Shorts/portrait, arbitrary font import/load/apply/export, and QCDS evidence update. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, template variety, and non-Chromium browser coverage.

runtimeGate.requirement: Chrome or headless browser confirms nonblank render, primary elements, and primary operations.
checks: custom font apply to text layer

followUpCandidates.item: Cross-browser checks for Safari, Firefox, and Edge
Real-device mobile checks for touch canvas editing and Image Lab drag gestures
